command:
uv run iris --config lib/iris/config/marin.yaml job run --no-wait \
  --enable-extra-resources --cpu 2 --memory 8GB --disk 32GB --timeout 172800 --max-retries 0 --max-preemption-retries 0 \
  --extra cpu --region us-central1 --zone us-central1-a \
  --job-name starcoder-tpp10-calibration \
  --exclude '^(checkpoints|logs|wandb)/' \
  --exclude '^experiments/domain_phase_mix/exploratory/.*(?<!\.py)$' \
  --exclude '^\.agents/(?!projects/starcoder_tpp10/releases/).*' \
  --exclude '^(docs|tests)/.*(?<!\.py)$' \
  --exclude '^lib/[^/]+/tests/.*(?<!\.py)$' \
  -e MARIN_PREFIX gs://marin-us-central1 \
  -e WANDB_API_KEY "$WANDB_API_KEY" \
  -- python -m experiments.domain_phase_mix.await_starcoder_tpp10_calibration \
  --authorization .agents/projects/starcoder_tpp10/releases/calibration_authorization.json \
  --output .agents/projects/starcoder_tpp10/live
name: starcoder-tpp10-calibration
